sourceTitle: Pasted Text: Viral Medical & Health Claim Statement
summary: The submitted content contains significant sensationalism, clickbait phrasing, and unverified medical assertions. 5 out of 8 claims were either false or unconfirmed.
recommendation: High Risk: Content exhibits classic manipulation tactics and misleading headlines. Do not distribute without primary medical literature confirmation.

keyHighlights: 2 claims explicitly refuted by WHO and CDC public health bulletins
3 unverified claims relying on anonymous or anecdotal testimonials
Clickbait framing and emotionally loaded vocabulary detected throughout text

claims.claimText: A newly discovered herbal extract guarantees 100% immunity against seasonal respiratory viruses.
claims.explanation: Refuted by health regulatory agencies. No scientific trial data supports 100% immunity claims.

sources.title: Snopes: Unproven Herbal Immunity Claims
sources.snippet: Medical experts confirm no single herbal supplement provides complete respiratory virus immunity.

claims.claimText: Clinical trial results were conducted across 3 major university medical centers in 2024.
claims.explanation: No trial registration numbers or peer-reviewed publication records could be verified in PubMed registries.

sources.title: FactCheck.org Health Review
sources.snippet: Unregistered clinical trials cannot be independently validated against medical standards.
